title: Grit
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.The beasts in Hedda Crane's pen warn Ashreach of dragons, but the wind off the Dune Sea has filled with grit and they no longer settle.

About

Given byHedda Crane
Level36
LengthLong
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

  • Dust Mote ×10

Steps

  1. Talk to Hedda Crane (outdoors near Ashreach) to get the quest.
  2. Kill 20 dust devils (20)
    Bring Hedda Crane 10 dust motes (10) - Dust Mote at 1830, 66
  3. Kill 10 sand devils (10)
  4. Kill Grit at 1786, 380
    Talk to Hedda Crane at 1831, 66

Rewards

Reward
Gold8,320
Character XP260,000
Quest points1

What Hedda Crane says

Hedda Crane: Look at this one. I shut it in a jar last night and it's still spinning.

Hedda Crane: Ordinary dust settles. This doesn't, so something out there keeps it moving. The worst of the grit blows in from the Wind-Carved Rocks.

Hedda Crane: Cole says the sand devils down by the old caravan have grown bigger this season. Thin those out, then go and see what lives in the rocks.

You: Something in the Wind-Carved Rocks was driving the grit. A dust devil the size of a house. It's gone.

Hedda Crane: Listen. Hear that? They went quiet an hour ago, and I thought a dragon was coming.

Hedda Crane: It was only the wind dropping. Next time they go quiet, it'll mean something again.

Hedda Crane: Here. Half the hamlet put something in. They sleep better when the pen does.

Handing it in

"Here. Half the hamlet put something in. They sleep better when the pen does."
